For \(M=(x,y)\) on \(y^2=4x\), the focus is \(F=(1,0)\) and the directrix is \(x=-1\), so
\[
|MF|=x+1.
\]
The circle has center \(O=(4,1)\), radius \(1\). Since no point of the parabola lies inside or on this circle, for fixed \(M\),
\[
\min_A |MA|=|MO|-1.
\]
Thus
\[
|MA|+|MF|\ge |MO|-1+(x+1)=x+|MO|.
\]
Let \(P=(0,y)\) be the projection of \(M\) onto the \(y\)-axis. Then \(x=|MP|\), so
\[
x+|MO|=|MP|+|MO|\ge |OP|=\sqrt{16+(y-1)^2}\ge 4.
\]
Equality requires \(y=1\) and \(O,M,P\) collinear. On the parabola, \(y=1\) gives
\[
x=\frac{y^2}{4}=\frac14.
\]
So equality is attained at \(M=\left(\frac14,1\right)\), with closest circle point \(A=(3,1)\). Therefore the minimum value is
\[
\boxed{4}.
\]
